items.title: x402 on Base mainnet: USDC EIP-712 domain name advertised as "USDC" instead of "USD Coin"
items.body_excerpt:
**Problem.** `app/x402/middleware.py` (the `USDC_TOKEN_METADATA` table, around lines 57-66 on `dev`) advertises `extra.name = "USDC"`, version "2", for network `base`. The Base mainnet USDC contract's EIP-712 `name()` is `"USD Coin"`. `"USDC"` is correct only on Base Sepolia.

**Impact.** Clients and facilitators build the EIP-3009 signing and verification domain from `extra`. On `X402_NETWORK=base`, signatures made against the advertised domain don't match the on-chain `DOMAIN_SEPARATOR`, so every mainnet payment fails verification. Nothing is lost, because it fails closed, but mainnet payments can't work. Startup validation (#407) doesn't check this value.

**Evidence.** Read-only calls to Base mainnet USDC:
- `name()` returns `"USD Coin"`, `version()` returns `"2"`, and `DOMAIN_SEPARATOR` is `0x02fa72…834f`.
- The separator computed with `"USDC"` on chain 8453 doesn't match it; the one computed with `"USD Coin"` does.

Found by the 2026-09 client audits. The CLI has the same bug on

items.title: Your x402 listing on the CDP Bazaar — one paid check, 5 October 2026
items.body_excerpt:
Hi,

We run AIMarket (modelmarket.dev). On 5 October 2026 we bought one call from 100 randomly drawn x402 sellers in the CDP Bazaar, each with the example request from its own listing, and checked what came back. Yours was one of them. We do not publish seller names; this note is only for you.

Your listing's example asks for OCR of an image with no text (a flag), so the paid example returned empty data, and $0.01 was settled. A buyer cannot tell from it that the service works.

Suggestion: Use an example image that contains text.

If you want the full evidence (request, raw response, transaction) or think we got something wrong, just reply — we will correct our record. Method and tool: https://github.com/alexar76/aicom/blob/main/docs/x402-delivery-survey.md

— AIMarket

items.title: Add AIMarket Hub (x402 V2, seller-direct, MCP + A2A)
items.body_excerpt:
Adds AIMarket Hub to AI Agent Integration.

- What: a federated market where agents buy capabilities per call; MCP endpoint https://modelmarket.dev/mcp

items.title: Add aimarket-bridges to Packages
items.body_excerpt:
Adds **aimarket-bridges** to *Community Projects → 📦 Packages*.

Two lines, then a LangGraph agent has 181 more `StructuredTool`s:

```python
from aimarket_bridges.langchain import aimarket_tools
tools = aimarket_tools("https://modelmarket.dev", intent="verifiable randomness")
```

Each tool is a live Hub capability (verifiable randomness, consensus, sequential-work proofs, …) with a signed receipt and a hard per-task spend cap. Bind them on `create_react_agent` as usual.

- Repo: https://github.com/alexar76/aimarket-bridges
- PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/aimarket-bridges/ — `pip install "aimarket-bridges[langgraph]"`
- Live hub: https://modelmarket.dev
- Write-up: https://dev.to/alexar76/181-more-tools-for-your-langgraph-agent-in-two-lines-2g76

The old “47” was one federated peer. Counted 2026-09-12 from the live Hub manifest: **181** federated capabilities across 14 hubs.

items.title: Add aimarket-oracle-gateway (verifiable oracle MCP server)
items.body_excerpt:
## Summary

Adds **alexar76/aimarket-oracle-gateway** to the **Security** section — a separate MCP server from our existing **Aggregators** entry (`aimarket-plugins` / mcp-packager).

MIT · Python · stdio MCP server exposing verifiable oracle tools for AI agents:
- **Platon VRF** — Ed25519-signed unbiasable randomness (`get_random`, `get_randomness_beacon`, `ask_oracle`)
- **Chronos VDF** — verifiable delay / proof-of-elapsed-time (`compute_vdf`, `verify_vdf`)
- **LUMEN reputation** — PageRank/EigenTrust trust scores (`get_reputation_scores`)
- `list_oracle_capabilities`

Pay-per-call over the [AIMarket Protocol v2](https://github.com/alexar76/aimarket-protocol); every result is independently verifiable. Fail-closed spend caps.

- Repo: https://github.com/alexar76/aimarket-oracle-gateway
- Glama: https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/alexar76/aimarket-oracle-gateway
